productionDecisions: Keep actual progress, state text, Enter and Retry readable from the first frame; the suggested4s paper entrance cannot delay functional content.
Use the existing verified Godot boot chain, progress callbacks, presenter and original Enter/Retry handlers. Do not copy the prototype LoaderUI state machine or loader-enter/loader-retry events.

Scope all decorative selectors to the loading surface and prefix their class names. Actual embedded prototype preview showed a large triangular clipping/washout; a generic.light collision with the host is a possible cause, not a confirmed production defect.
Morning light stays inside the decorative scene below the ink and controls; no whole-page white overlay.
Use real-byte progress and a transform scale for decorative progress fill. Do not copy the prototype width transition, illustrative42percent or any fake95/99percent verification value.
Keep100vh and safe-area0px fallbacks; do not copy dynamic-viewport-only sizing.
Ready immediately shows the original Enter button and a static final frame, regardless of elapsed animation time or explicit pause.
Keep generic starting copy because Continue can restore a later chapter; do not promise that every start walks into the dorm.
No new calendar month, unearned check-in success, emerald/check badge, highlighted nighttime portrait, automatic sound or story/save write.
Use a source-coordinate160px scene and lossless4x WebP. All image blocks and source colors are audited against the locked art policy.
Keep body text native and readable without duplicating the5.9MB game font in the boot transfer; the7:55 title uses original inline grid glyphs. Bootstrap UI colors use the locked palette.
